Specification: This module models the structure and well-formedness of parenthesis expressions using tokens. It defines a record type Token with a type field (which can be 'left', 'right', or 'other') and an id field. The recursive operator ParenDepth computes the nesting depth of parentheses in a sequence of tokens up to a given index, incrementing or decrementing the depth based on the token type. IsWellFormed checks that a sequence never dips below zero depth and ends at zero, ensuring balanced parentheses. ExprOfMaxLen constructs the set of all well-formed sequences of tokens up to a given length n. The module does not specify a temporal system or algorithm, but rather provides structural definitions for reasoning about parenthesis expressions.
